system.description:
When an enemy look into your eyes, they see an Apex predator. A beast of a person who doesn’t see them as an equal, but as prey. You can take the Demoralize skill action as a Bonus action, and you can attempt it on creatures any number of times instead of once per hour.

Beginning at 7th level, increase the ranks of Demoralized you inflict by +1. Beginning at 15th level, when you take the Demoralize skill action, you can instead target all creatures you can see within 20 feet of you.
